_comment: Dealer stock pages feeding the market-valuation layer (Layer 1: real market). All enabled entries are fetched in parallel on every valuation (default 2 pages each — `pages` overrides; sites that ignore ?page=N just return page 1 again, and identical prices are deduped); only cards whose title mentions the vehicle's make AND model (within ±1 year) count. `match` adds title keywords, `cardSelector` overrides listing-card detection, `pageParam` changes the pagination query param, `enabled: false` parks a URL without hitting it. Verify each entry with `npm run check:dealers` before enabling. JS-only sites need the headless worker: run TruCRM's `npm run worker:dev` (or deploy dist/scrape-worker.cjs) and set SCRAPER_SERVICE_URL in .env.
